title.en: Why you cannot just round, and what a yes/no variable is
title.zh: 为什么不能直接四舍五入，以及“是/否”变量是什么

description.en: Half an advertisement makes no sense. See why rounding an LP answer can lose, then turn yes/no decisions into 0-1 variables and write “only if”, “at most one” and “fixed cost” as lines a solver can use.
description.zh: 半条广告没有意义。看看为什么把 LP 的答案四舍五入可能吃亏，再把“做不做”的决策变成 0-1 变量，把“只有……才……”“至多一个”“固定成本”写成求解器能用的行。

description.en: Rounding an LP answer to get the integer answer
description.zh: 把 LP 答案四舍五入当作整数答案

description.en: Adding a yes/no variable for a fixed cost without linking it to the quantity
description.zh: 为固定成本加了 0-1 变量，却没有把它和数量连起来

text.en: Princess Brides, a wedding planner, buys radio ads. A prime-time ad costs \$390 and reaches 8,200 people; an off-peak ad costs \$240 and reaches 5,100. The weekly budget is \$1,800, she wants at least 2 prime-time ads, and the station sells at most 6 off-peak ads. Goal: the largest audience. The blue dots are the plans that use whole ads.
text.zh: 婚礼策划公司 Princess Brides 买电台广告。一条黄金时段广告 \$390，触达 8,200 人；一条非黄金时段广告 \$240，触达 5,100 人。每周预算 \$1,800，她要求黄金时段广告至少 2 条，电台非黄金时段广告最多卖 6 条。目标：触达的人最多。蓝点是用整条广告的那些计划。

alt.en: The plan plane with the whole-number plans marked as dots.
alt.zh: 标出了整数计划（蓝点）的计划平面。

label.en: Weekly budget
label.zh: 每周预算

label.en: At least 2 prime-time ads
label.zh: 黄金时段广告至少 2 条

label.en: At most 6 off-peak ads
label.zh: 非黄金时段广告至多 6 条

caption.en: Press the button: the green ring is the LP’s best plan, the gold ring the best whole-number plan.
caption.zh: 按按钮：绿圈是 LP 的最优计划，金圈是最好的整数计划。

title.zh: 把 LP 答案四舍五入？

prompt.en: The LP’s best plan is 2 prime-time and 4.25 off-peak ads, reaching 38,075 people. A manager says: round 4.25 to 4 and you are done, 2 and 4, reaching 36,800. Is that the best whole-number plan?
prompt.zh: LP 的最优计划是 2 条黄金时段和 4.25 条非黄金时段广告，触达 38,075 人。经理说：把 4.25 四舍五入成 4 就行了，2 条和 4 条，触达 36,800 人。这是最好的整数计划吗？

label.en: No. 4 prime-time and 1 off-peak is allowed and reaches 37,900: the best whole-number plan can be far from the LP’s corner.
label.zh: 不是。4 条黄金时段加 1 条非黄金时段是允许的，触达 37,900：最好的整数计划可能离 LP 的角很远。

label.en: Yes: the nearest whole numbers are always best.
label.zh: 是：最近的整数总是最好的。

feedback.en: The picture shows the blue dots: the best one is not the nearest to the corner.
feedback.zh: 图上有蓝点：最好的那个并不是离角最近的。

label.en: Rounding up (2 and 5) is better.
label.zh: 向上取整（2 和 5）更好。

feedback.en: 2 prime-time and 5 off-peak costs \$1,980: over the \$1,800 budget. Rounding up can leave the allowed set.
feedback.zh: 2 条加 5 条要 \$1,980：超出 \$1,800 的预算。向上取整可能走出允许区域。

explain.en: Rounding can break a limit (rounding up) or leave profit on the table (rounding down). Integer programming searches the whole-number plans themselves.
explain.zh: 取整可能破坏某条限制（向上取）或白白丢掉收益（向下取）。整数规划搜索的是整数计划本身。

head.zh: 在 Solver 或 LINDO 里

rows.zh: 一些是整数或 0-1，一些连续

rows.en: open a plant (0-1) and ship units (any number)
rows.zh: 开不开工厂（0-1）、运多少件（任意数）

text.en: The picture is not a polygon with corners any more but a cloud of dots, so the “best plan is at a corner” rule is gone. Solvers search cleverly among the dots, which is why they are slower than for LPs. The LP answer is still useful: it is an upper bound for a maximisation (no whole-number plan can beat it).
text.zh: 图不再是带角的多边形，而是一团点，所以“最优计划在角上”的规则不再成立。求解器在这些点里聪明地搜索，所以比解 LP 慢。LP 的答案仍然有用：对最大化问题，它是上界（没有整数计划能超过它）。

title.en: A yes/no variable, and what each statement keeps
title.zh: “是/否”变量，以及每句话保留什么

text.en: Quemo Chemical may build any of three projects: a catalytic converter ($x_1$), a software program ($x_2$), a warehouse expansion ($x_3$). Each variable is 1 if the project is built and 0 if not, so three projects give 8 combinations. Every statement in words removes some of the 8, and the line you write must remove exactly those.
text.zh: Quemo Chemical 可以做三个项目中的任何几个：催化转化器（$x_1$）、软件（$x_2$）、仓库扩建（$x_3$）。每个变量是 1 表示做、0 表示不做，所以三个项目有 8 种组合。每句话都会排除其中几种，你写的那一行必须正好排除这些。

alt.en: Write the line for each statement; the eight combinations show which stay and which go.
alt.zh: 为每句话写一行；八种组合会显示哪些保留、哪些被排除。

label.en: The converter (x1) only if the software (x2) is bought too
label.zh: 催化转化器（x1）只有在也买软件（x2）时才买

label.en: At most one of the converter and the software
label.zh: 催化转化器和软件至多买一个

label.en: At most two of the three projects
label.zh: 三个项目至多做两个

label.en: The converter and the warehouse together, or neither
label.zh: 催化转化器和仓库要么一起做，要么都不做

label.en: Exactly one of the three projects
label.zh: 三个项目正好做一个

caption.en: Choose a statement, write its line (for example with + and ≤), and check. Blue edge: the combinations that should stay.
caption.zh: 选一句话，写出它的行（比如用 + 和 ≤），然后检查。蓝边：应该保留的组合。

text.en: The company has \$20,000 in year 1 and \$16,000 in year 2. The converter costs 8,000 then 7,000 and has a net present value of \$25,000; the software 6,000 then 4,000 and \$18,000; the warehouse 12,000 then 8,000 and \$32,000. At most two projects, and the converter only if the software is bought. The lines are: $8000x_1 + 6000x_2 + 12000x_3 \le 20000$, $7000x_1 + 4000x_2 + 8000x_3 \le 16000$, $x_1 + x_2 + x_3 \le 2$, $x_2 - x_1 \ge 0$, all 0 or 1.

prompt.en: With those lines, what is the largest total net present value (in dollars)?
prompt.zh: 按这些行，最大的总净现值是多少美元？

explain.en: Of the 8 combinations, 5 keep every line; the best builds the projects (x1, x2, x3) = (0, 1, 1), for \$50,000. The warehouse and the software together fit both years’ funds; the converter cannot come without the software.
explain.zh: 8 种组合里有 5 种守住了所有的行；最好的是 (x1, x2, x3) = (0, 1, 1)，净现值 \$50,000。仓库和软件一起，两年的资金都够；催化转化器离不开软件。

title.en: A fixed cost: yes/no with a quantity

text.en: Martin-Beck has a St. Louis plant (30,000 units) and may build new plants in Detroit (fixed cost \$175,000, capacity 10,000), Toledo (\$300,000, 20,000), Denver (\$375,000, 30,000) and Kansas City (\$500,000, 40,000). Boston, Atlanta and Houston want 30,000, 20,000 and 20,000 units. Which plants should be built, and what is shipped?

Two kinds of variable: $y_i = 1$ if the new plant $i$ is built (0 otherwise), and $x_{ij}$ units shipped from plant $i$ to centre $j$. They must be **linked**: a plant that is not built ships nothing. That link is the whole idea:
text.zh: 两类变量：$y_i = 1$ 表示新工厂 $i$ 建了（否则 0），以及 $x_{ij}$ 表示从工厂 $i$ 运到中心 $j$ 的件数。必须把它们**连起来**：没建的工厂什么也运不出。这个连接就是全部的想法：

text.en: If $y_1 = 0$ the right side is 0, so Detroit ships nothing; if $y_1 = 1$ the limit is Detroit’s capacity, 10,000. The objective adds the fixed cost only for the plants built: $\text{shipping} + 175000y_1 + 300000y_2 + 375000y_3 + 500000y_4$. The number in front of $y_i$ is the capacity: it plays the part of a very big number “M” that is only as big as it needs to be.
text.zh: 若 $y_1 = 0$，右边是 0，底特律什么也运不出；若 $y_1 = 1$，限制就是底特律的产能 10,000。目标函数只为建了的工厂加固定成本：运输成本 $+ 175000y_1 + 300000y_2 + 375000y_3 + 500000y_4$。$y_i$ 前面的数就是产能：它起着“很大的数 M”的作用，只是恰好够大。

prompt.en: A student adds the fixed costs $175000y_1 + \ldots$ to the objective but forgets the line $x_{11} + x_{12} + x_{13} \le 10000y_1$ (keeping only Detroit’s capacity as a plain 10,000 limit). What does the solver do?
prompt.zh: 一位同学把固定成本 $175000y_1 + \ldots$ 加进了目标函数，却忘了 $x_{11} + x_{12} + x_{13} \le 10000y_1$ 这一行（只保留了底特律产能 10,000 这条普通限制）。求解器会怎么做？

label.en: It sets every $y_i$ to 0, ships from the plants anyway and pays no fixed cost.
label.zh: 它把每个 $y_i$ 都设成 0，照样从各工厂发货，却不付固定成本。

label.en: It builds every plant.
label.zh: 它把每个工厂都建了。

feedback.en: Building costs money and nothing in the model asks for it.
feedback.zh: 建厂要花钱，模型里没有任何东西要求建。

label.en: The model is infeasible.
label.zh: 模型无可行解。

feedback.en: It is feasible; the fixed cost is simply never forced.
feedback.zh: 是有可行解的；固定成本只是从来没被强制要求。

explain.en: A yes/no variable only means something once a line ties it to the thing it switches on.
explain.zh: 一个“是/否”变量，只有当一条限制把它和它所开关的东西连起来，才有意义。

prompt.en: With the fixed costs and shipping, what is the least total annual cost (in dollars) over all choices of new plants?
prompt.zh: 算上固定成本和运输成本，所有新建工厂的选择中，最低的年总成本是多少美元？

explain.en: Trying all 16 combinations of new plants (and the shipping LP for each) gives the least total \$860,000, building: Kansas City. The solver reaches the same by branch and bound.
explain.zh: 把新建工厂的 16 种组合都试一遍（每种解一个运输 LP），最低总成本是 \$860,000，建：堪萨斯城。求解器用分支定界得到同样的结果。

rows.zh: $A$ 只有在 $B$ 时才做（如果……那么）

rows.en: the sum counts how many are chosen

rows.zh: 数量 $x$ 只有在 $y = 1$ 时才有

rows.en: $M$ is any number at least as big as $x$ can ever be (the plant’s capacity)
rows.zh: $M$ 是不小于 $x$ 可能取值的任意数（比如产能）

text.en: The deck’s warehouse example uses three yes/no variables per warehouse and a penalty for being used below a minimum throughput: the same “big M” links, one for “is it used”, one for “is it under the minimum”. Each one is a line of the last kind.
text.zh: 课件里的仓库例子，每个仓库用三个是/否变量，外加使用量低于最低吞吐量时的罚金：同样是“大 M”的连接，一个管“有没有用”，一个管“是不是低于最低量”。每个都是最后一种线。

prompt.en: A university can pick among 4 hardware and 4 software projects (budget \$150,000, space 25,000, hardware time 36, software time 24; at least 4 projects, at least one of each kind). The importance ratings are 0.191, 0.107, 0.091, 0.094 (hardware) and 0.126, 0.132, 0.116, 0.144 (software); costs 71,400, 57,000, 50,000, 35,700, 4,300, 2,100, 6,400, 28,600; hardware space 12,500, 2,500, 10,800, 625; hardware time 24, 6, 15, 12; software time 6, 12, 9, none for the 8th. What is the largest total importance? (three decimals)

explain.en: With 8 yes/no variables there are 256 combinations; checking each against the lines gives the best 0.687, choosing the projects [1, 4, 5, 6, 8].
explain.zh: 8 个是/否变量有 256 种组合；逐个按各行检查，最好的是 0.687，选的项目是 [1, 4, 5, 6, 8]。

prompt.en: In an LP, the best plan always sits at a corner. In an integer program:
prompt.zh: 在 LP 里，最优计划总在角上。在整数规划里：

label.en: Not necessarily: the best whole-number plan can be inside the allowed set.
label.zh: 不一定：最好的整数计划可能在允许区域内部。

label.en: Still always at a corner.
label.zh: 仍然总在角上。

feedback.en: The best dot of the lattice is usually not a corner.
feedback.zh: 点阵里最好的那个点通常不是角。

label.en: Always at the rounded corner.
label.zh: 总在四舍五入后的那个角。

feedback.en: The first page of this lesson shows it is not.
feedback.zh: 这一课第一页就说明不是。

explain.en: The corner rule belongs to continuous variables.
explain.zh: “在角上”这条规则属于连续变量。

prompt.en: Total supply is 800 and total demand is 600. The transportation table needs:
prompt.zh: 总供应是 800，总需求是 600。运输表需要：

label.en: a dummy destination of 200, at cost 0.
label.zh: 一个 200 的虚拟需求地，运费为 0。

label.en: a dummy origin of 200, at cost 0.
label.zh: 一个 200 的虚拟供应地，运费为 0。

feedback.en: A dummy origin is for the case where demand is larger.
feedback.zh: 虚拟供应地用于需求更大的情形。

label.en: a dummy destination of 200 with a high cost.
label.zh: 一个 200 的虚拟需求地，运费很高。

feedback.en: Nothing is really shipped to a dummy: its cost is 0.
feedback.zh: 没有东西真的运给虚拟项：它的运费是 0。

explain.en: Surplus supply goes to a dummy destination.
explain.zh: 多余的供应去虚拟需求地。
